note: Election of aldermen (one per ward) and councillors (two per ward), polled on Wednesday 17 May 1967. The Belfast Telegraph nomination report lists all six wards; polls were needed only for North (alderman and councillors), Eden (alderman and councillors) and the West Ward aldermanship (the Larne Times of 11 May 1967 prints the notices of poll for exactly these). All other seats were filled unopposed. Two nominees for two seats. Labels printed (both U.). Returned unopposed.
